title: 第9章取死之道
slug: 斗罗开局被逼入赘对象宁荣荣
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

包间的大门被一脚踹开，门板震得嗡嗡作响，桌上的酒杯都跟着晃了晃。

门口，一道身影大摇大摆地走了进来。

那是一个中年男人，身形高大，穿着一身武魂殿主教的华贵长袍，面容阴鸷，鹰钩鼻，薄嘴唇，一双三角眼带着常年居高临下养出来的傲慢与刻薄。

身后跟着两名黑袍护卫，魂力外放，修为不低。

迈尔斯。

他大步走进雅间，目光首先落在了思龙身上，嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。

“敢抢我的包间，我当是谁呢。思龙，原来是你啊，怎么，几天不见，这么勇了？”

思龙脸色微变，但想到接下来会发生什么，心底不由升起一抹快意。

“迈尔斯主教，这两位是我铁匠协会最重要的客人，今天给个面子。”

“面子？”

迈尔斯嗤笑一声。

下一刻，他抬腿就是一脚。

“砰！“

思龙被踹得整个人倒飞出去，撞在墙上，发出一声闷响，又跌坐在地。嘴角渗出一丝血迹，但硬是一声没吭，只是撑着墙壁慢慢坐直了身子。

“你他妈的一个打铁的，哪来的面子？老子又为什么要给你面子！”

迈尔斯收回腿，居高临下地看着低着头的思龙，眼中满是轻蔑。

迈尔斯哼了一声，不再理会他，目光终于落在了桌边坐着的两人身上。

一个跟骷髅似的老头，枯槁瘦削，半阖着眼，像是随时都会睡过去。

另外一个——

紫发如瀑，淡金色的瞳孔，过分清秀的面容。

迈尔斯的视线在那个紫发青年身上停了一瞬，眉头微微皱了皱。

不知为何，看着这张脸，他心中涌起一股莫名的感觉。

说不清道不明，像是在很久很久以前，见过这个人。

自己，是不是在哪见过他？

那个念头只是一闪而过，便被抛在了脑后。

不重要。

在庚辛城，他就是绝对的掌控者，没人敢跟自己作对。

“一个糟老头子，一个娘娘腔，就你们还贵客，呵忒。”

迈尔斯双手抱胸，下巴微微扬起，语气懒散而傲慢，仿佛在驱赶两只碍眼的野狗。

“你们是自己滚出去，还是让我帮你们？”

雅间里安静了一瞬。

而此刻——

江蓠的指尖在桌下微微颤抖，攥紧的拳头骨节泛白，指甲几乎嵌入掌心。

那双淡金色的瞳孔中，血色正在以肉眼可见的速度蔓延。

十三年。

十三年了。

那张脸还是那么的熟悉，这个声音还是那么的令人作呕！

杀了上千人积攒下的杀气，在这一刻，像是被点燃的火药，升腾而起。

胸口衣领处，蛛儿也感受到了她的情绪，八条腿骤然绷紧，复眼中泛起深紫色的幽光，小小的身躯微微发颤。

见两人没有反应，迈尔斯明显有些不耐烦了。

“听不懂人话？我说——”

Page (1/3)

The door to the private room was kicked open, the door panel buzzed, and the wine glasses on the table swayed.

At the door, a figure walked in swaggeringly.

It was a middle-aged man, tall, wearing the luxurious robes of the Bishop of Wuhun Palace, with a sinister face, a hooked nose, thin lips, and a pair of triangular eyes with arrogance and meanness cultivated from years of condescension.

Followed by two black-robed guards, their soul power was released and their cultivation level was not low.

Myers.

He strode into the elegant room, his eyes first fell on Silong, and a sneer curled up at the corner of his mouth.

"Who do I think you are if you dare to rob my private room? Silong, it turns out to be you. How come you are so brave after not seeing each other for a few days?"

Silong's expression changed slightly, but when he thought about what would happen next, he couldn't help but feel a sense of joy in his heart.

"Bishop Miles, these two are the most important guests of my Blacksmith Guild. Please show me some respect today."

"Face?"

Miles scoffed.

The next moment, he raised his leg and kicked it.

"Bang!"

Silong was kicked so hard that he flew backwards, hit the wall with a muffled sound, and fell to the ground again.A trace of blood seeped out from the corner of his mouth, but he remained silent and slowly sat upright while holding on to the wall.

"You're a fucking blacksmith, how can you get any face? Why should I give you face!"

Miles retracted his legs and looked down at Silong, who had his head lowered, with contempt in his eyes.

Miles snorted and ignored him, his eyes finally falling on the two people sitting at the table.

An old man who looked like a skeleton, withered and thin, eyes half closed, as if he would fall asleep at any moment.

Another one——

Purple hair like a waterfall, pale golden pupils, and an overly delicate face.

Miles' eyes paused on the purple-haired young man for a moment, and his brows wrinkled slightly.

For some reason, looking at this face, he felt an inexplicable feeling in his heart.

It was unclear, but it seemed like I had seen this person a long, long time ago.

Have you seen him somewhere?

The thought just passed through my mind for a moment and was forgotten.

unimportant.

In Gengxin City, he is the absolute controller, and no one dares to go against him.

"A bad old man and a sissy, you are the only one who is a distinguished guest, haha."

Miles crossed his arms, raised his chin slightly, and spoke in a lazy and arrogant tone, as if he was driving away two unsightly wild dogs.

"Do you want to get out on your own, or do you want me to help you?"

The private room was quiet for a moment.

And at this moment——

Jiang Li's fingertips trembled slightly under the table, the knuckles of her clenched fists were white, and her nails were almost embedded in her palms.

In those pale golden pupils, blood was spreading at a speed visible to the naked eye.

Thirteen years.

Thirteen years.

That face is still so familiar, and the voice is still so disgusting!

The murderous aura accumulated after killing thousands of people rose up like ignited gunpowder at this moment.

At the collar of her chest, Zhu'er also felt her emotions. Her eight legs suddenly tightened, her compound eyes glowed with a deep purple light, and her little body trembled slightly.

Seeing no reaction from the two of them, Miles was obviously a little impatient.

"Can't you understand people? I said -"
